description: Regression baselines for `brasscribe bench`, taken from docs/research/10-benchmark-results.md. Each suite cites the section its numbers come from. Default tolerance applies unless a metric sets its own. higher_is_better=false marks error-type metrics. Change a number only deliberately, together with the doc.

chorales-transcription.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Results (mean over 10 chorales), 50 ms; 100 ms values from 'Chorales re-scored at 100 ms'

slakh-transcription.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Ground-truth fix: Slakh bass octave, corrected results (100 ms)

quant-chorales.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Rhythm, Results (10 chorales), penalties x20 rows. The Beat This! row is measured on all 10 chorales (0.490 / 0.930 / 0.771); the doc's '~0.45 / 0.92 / 0.76' matches the 9 chorales without Drese (0.464 / 0.922 / 0.760) and is being corrected

quant-urmp.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: URMP brass, Rhythm (reference notes); Beat This! row with metrical-level selection

melody.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Notation, Melody line (melody_bench), onset F1 at 100 ms

consensus-chorales.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Consensus, Chorales (MuScriptor + Basic Pitch on mix): weighted vote F1 0.76
open_questions: The doc does not state the threshold behind 'weighted vote F1 0.76'; the gate uses the best F1 over thresholds 0.3-0.8.

consensus-chorales-retuned.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Basic Pitch on the recording retuned to A = 440

consensus-urmp.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: URMP brass, Transcription: consensus, agreement threshold 0.8

consensus-slakh.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Consensus, Slakh (4 sources): best F1 0.63 at threshold 0.8; threshold 0.7 precision 0.60

arrange.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Arrangement, ground-truth benchmark; quartet keys: 'Quartet arrangement'

mikkel-golden.source: data/golden/mikkel-arranged-band: arranging the cached Mikkel layers with the current code reproduces it exactly (fractions, so the gate holds when the golden output is re-saved deliberately)

musescore-roundtrip.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: MuseScore gate; every pitched part must survive the MuseScore re-export

durations.source: measured by this suite after the durations-from-audio change; not yet in 10-benchmark-results.md (brasscribe bench durations)

freetime.source: measured by this suite after the free-time change; not yet in 10-benchmark-results.md (brasscribe bench freetime)

readability.source: qa/tools/musicxml_readability.py --check --baseline qa/reports/mikkel-golden-readability.json passes on a fresh Mikkel arrangement; per difficulty since the fast-notes solo path (docs/plan/fast-notes.md §7): faithful with the Solo Cornet 16th limit at 65 %, standard and easier on the unchanged thresholds

solo-ondevice.source: data/runs/apple/entertainer-ref/layered, made by apps/apple/scripts/make-ondevice-reference.sh; the Play apps' on-device solo path matches it with F1 1.0

quartet-audio.source: 10-benchmark-results.md: Quartet arrangement, from recordings; alto and tenor recall since the melody is left out of the harmony by onset tolerance instead of rounded onsets

solo-instruments.source: docs/plan/my-instrument.md §1.2, §6.3 and §7.1: the solo path per instrument, today's (no seat) and the seat's; cornet_moved since the faithful soloist placement: docs/plan/trumpet.md §2.5; since the fast-notes solo path (docs/plan/fast-notes.md §7): more right notes, and far fewer wrong ones (trumpet 16 -> 3, flugelhorn 17 -> 8), so q_hit is a share of a handful; q_missed: wrong notes without a "?" per 100 notes (trumpet 0.93 -> 0.25, flugelhorn 0.87 -> 0.62)

seat-voices.source: docs/plan/my-instrument.md §1.3 and §7.3: each seat's voice from the brass4 mixes by range

fast-notes.source: docs/plan/fast-notes.md §7-§8: the solo path on the frozen fast-notes clips (real trumpet samples dry, in a hall and through Mega-53, with the must-stay-one-note controls), after contour onsets, dense quantization and trill notation at standard and easier; errors: clips and builds that failed (a failed stage would score as empty, which a control counts as perfect)

bass-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench bass-tab) on the Slakh excerpts with one bass stem, a full mix (song) and the bass stem alone (instrument), and on bass lines synthesized here at the bottom of a four-string (low_e) and of a five-string (low_b); not in 10-benchmark-results.md. violations is a hard gate: a tab must be playable

guitar-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench guitar-tab): GuitarSet's guitar alone, single lines (solo) and comping (comp), the players the rules were set on (tune: 00 to 02) apart from the players they are quoted for (report: 03 to 05); and the guitars of the Slakh excerpts from the separator's guitar stem (song). Not in 10-benchmark-results.md. violations is a hard gate: a tab must be playable

ukulele-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench ukulele-tab) on passages written in small_tab_bench.py and rendered with FluidSynth and the MuseScore General SoundFont, the instrument alone (instrument) and separated from a mix with a bass and drums (song). Rendered, one preset: weak evidence. The note rules were set on GuitarSet; the few chosen with these passages were chosen with the groups not named heldout, which are only reported. Not in 10-benchmark-results.md. violations is a hard gate

mandolin-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench mandolin-tab) on passages written in small_tab_bench.py and rendered with FluidSynth and the MuseScore General SoundFont, the instrument alone (instrument) and separated from a mix with a bass and drums (song). Rendered, one preset: weak evidence. The note rules were set on GuitarSet; the few chosen with these passages were chosen with the groups not named heldout, which are only reported. Not in 10-benchmark-results.md. violations is a hard gate

guitar-rendered-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench guitar-rendered-tab) on passages written in small_tab_bench.py and rendered with FluidSynth and the MuseScore General SoundFont: a guitar's open chords picked and strummed, and a melody, alone (instrument) and separated from a mix with a bass and drums (song). The rules for overtones were chosen with guitar_nylon and guitar_steel (and GuitarSet's players 00 to 02); the two heldout groups were not used. Rendered: weak evidence. Not in 10-benchmark-results.md. violations is a hard gate

meter-tab.source: measured by this suite (brasscribe bench meter-tab) on eight passages written in meter_tab_bench.py and rendered with FluidSynth and the MuseScore General SoundFont, one instrument alone. tracked_ok is the bar as the beat tracker found it (what the tab had before bar_beats), meter_ok the bar that is written. Rendered, one take each: weak evidence. Not in 10-benchmark-results.md
